papers.title: ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model. Forward-only zeroth-order (ZO) methods, such as Evolution Strategies (ES) and its top-k variant Augmented Random Search (ARS), avoid these overheads via reward-guided weight perturbations, yet remain unexplored for VLM reasoning. We find that directly applying standard ES or vanilla ARS to VLMs suffers from two fundamental failure modes: (i) patch-grid overfitting, fitting fragile grid-specific visual token artifacts while ignoring spatial invariants, and (ii) catastrophic forgetting, degrading general perception and out-of-distribution (OOD) tasks due to unbounded high-rank parameter and policy drift. We propose ARS-VLM, a visually aligned Augmented Random Search framework for forward-only VLM post-training. First, ARS-VLM extracts a contrastive visual basis from bilinearly paired cross-grid views, concentrating perturbations on shared visual signals while suppressing patch-shift artifacts. Second, ARS-VLM anchors shallow visual-fusion layers with a soft subspace prior while freeing deep reasoning layers, restraining policy drift without a reference model. Third, ARS-VLM scores perturbations on paired views to discard view-fragile directions during top-k selection. We evaluate ARS-VLM on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3-VL-8B on multimodal reasoning tasks. On 8B, ARS-VLM reaches 61.0% validation accuracy in 20 steps versus 150 for GRPO (7.5x fewer optimization steps) and avoids the late OOD collapse of vanilla ARS and ES. Moreover, ARS-VLM achieves 75.41% single-view micro accuracy across seven OOD vision reasoning benchmarks, compared with 75.31% for full-parameter GRPO, using forward-only post-training.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ARS-VLM，一种视觉对齐的增强随机搜索框架，用于视觉语言模型的前向仅后训练，避免反向传播开销，并缓解 patch-grid 过拟合与灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 基于对比视觉基从双线性配对的跨网格视图中提取共享视觉信号；用软子空间先验锚定浅层视觉融合层；在 top-k 选择中对配对视图打分以丢弃视图脆弱方向。在 Qwen3-VL-4B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 上评估多模态推理任务。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于检索增强与对齐、强化学习、持续学习及多模态学习交叉方向，关注 VLM 后训练中的对齐与遗忘问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告了在 Qwen3-VL 系列上的结果，未说明在其他 VLM 架构或更广泛任务上的泛化性；与 GRPO 的步骤数比较未详细说明计算成本口径。

papers.title: BioLoom: Scaling Biomedical Vision-Language Models by Learning from the Structure of Scientific Articles
papers.abstract: The development of biomedical vision-language models (VLMs) with contrastive image-text pretraining has been driven by scaling to increasingly large and diverse image-text datasets. Beyond scaling, further progress can come from learning richer representations from existing data. We hypothesize that the structure of scientific literature itself provides an additional source of supervision: figures, panels, captions, and accompanying article text encode rich relationships across modalities. Yet, treating these as independent image-text pairs overlooks their relationships. To address this limitation, we incorporate these structural relationships into contrastive image-text supervision. We preserve exact image-text matches while introducing weaker positive supervision for related pairs, such as a panel and the caption of a sibling panel. We upweight cross-article negatives of the same content type to encourage finer discrimination. We also enrich panel descriptions using visual content, original figure captions, and mentioning paragraphs. Pairing panels with these descriptions and whole figures with their original captions yields Loom52M, a dataset of 52.4 million image-text pairs spanning scientific charts and biomedical images. Using Loom52M, BioLoom (DFN-2B) achieves 56.82% domain-balanced mean accuracy across 67 zero-shot classification tasks from 43 datasets in 10 domains, compared with 48.77% for MedPMC-CLIP. On BioLoomBench with concise captions and BioMedFlickr, it achieves bidirectional mean Recall@1 of 63.20% and 10.59%, versus 46.37% and 7.55% for the respective strongest evaluated baselines, BiomedCLIP and MedPMC-CLIP. Code, datasets, benchmarks, and models are available at https://bioloom-clip.github.io/.

summary.takeaway: 提出 BioLoom，利用科学文献结构（图、面板、标题、正文）构建更丰富的对比监督，并发布 Loom52M 数据集与 BioLoom (DFN-2B) 模型，提升生物医学视觉语言模型的零样本分类与检索性能。
summary.methods: 保留精确图文匹配，为相关对（如面板与兄弟面板标题）引入较弱正监督；对同内容类型的跨文章负样本上加权；用视觉内容、原图标题和提及段落丰富面板描述。构建 52.4M 图文对数据集，在 67 个零样本分类任务和多个检索基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于预训练、多模态学习与跨模态理解方向，通过数据结构和对比学习改进生物医学 VLM 的表征。
summary.caveat: 摘要未详细说明结构监督在不同文献质量或领域下的鲁棒性；性能提升主要基于特定基准，未讨论计算成本与数据构建偏差。

papers.title: From Rewarding What Models Say to How They Think: Attention Process Reward Model for LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become an important component in large language models (LLMs). However, existing RL approaches focus on final outputs or textual solution trajectories, leading to coarse-grained rewards and unreliable reasoning. Such paradigms focus mainly on what the model outputs while overlooking how the model internally reasons. Therefore, can we reward how a model thinks internally rather than merely what it says? We first reveal the problem of textual reward aliasing in existing reward modeling approaches. Motivated by this, we propose the Attention Process Reward Model (APRM), which assigns internal rewards based on hidden states and attention maps to capture high-quality reasoning patterns. With only approximately 46M parameters, APRM is trained using ranking and counterfactual objectives, and its reward guides RL optimization while being periodically updated to handle distribution shifts. Integrated with representative RL methods, APRM achieved an average pass@8 gain of 2.88\%. Our results demonstrate the promise of incorporating internal reasoning signals into RL for LLMs.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Attention Process Reward Model (APRM)，基于隐藏状态和注意力图分配内部奖励，以奖励模型的内部推理模式而非仅最终输出，缓解文本奖励别名问题。
summary.methods: APRM 约 46M 参数，使用排序和反事实目标训练，奖励引导 RL 优化并定期更新以应对分布漂移。与代表性 RL 方法集成，报告平均 pass@8 提升 2.88%。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于大语言模型、强化学习与奖励学习方向，关注过程奖励与内部推理信号的对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出平均 pass@8 增益，未说明在不同模型规模、任务类型上的方差与泛化性；内部奖励的可解释性和训练稳定性未详细讨论。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Correctness: A Surrogate for Confidence Learning in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Confidence estimation for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) aims to assess how likely a particular generated response is to be correct. We investigate how learning this assessment can benefit from the model's predictive reliability on the underlying query. Binary correctness supervision, however, assigns identical labels to occasional errors and frequent failures, as well as isolated successes and consistent success. These outcomes can arise from substantially different predictive behavior under stochastic decoding. We propose a confidence-learning framework that supplements realized response correctness with query-level predictive reliability. We estimate reliability through repeated generations under a fixed model and decoding configuration, then combine the empirical success rate with individual correctness to construct a graded confidence surrogate. The surrogate differentiates responses sharing the same correctness label while preserving the average predictive reliability of the sampled response pool. To learn this target, we condition an independent confidence estimator on the query and its full generated response, and optimize backbone LoRA adapters together with a projection and scalar confidence head using mean squared error. Repeated sampling is required only for supervision construction; inference scores an individual response without additional generations. We establish ordering and mean preservation properties of the surrogate and derive a selective-risk bound connecting population surrogate prediction error to the error rate among accepted responses. We evaluate the framework across language and vision-language models, examining confidence calibration and selective prediction.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种置信度学习框架，用查询级预测可靠性补充二元正确性监督，构建分级置信度代理目标，以改善 LLM 和 VLM 的置信度校准与选择性预测。
summary.methods: 在固定模型与解码配置下重复生成估计可靠性，结合经验成功率与个体正确性构造代理；以查询和完整生成响应为条件训练独立置信度估计器，优化 LoRA 适配器、投影和标量置信头（MSE）。推理时无需额外生成。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于大语言模型、多模态学习与对齐方向，关注置信度估计与选择性预测。
summary.caveat: 监督构造需要重复采样，可能带来训练成本；摘要未给出具体校准误差或选择性预测的数值结果，实际部署效果需进一步验证。

papers.title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
papers.abstract: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds, a benchmark of visual puzzles where the agent views a large world through a small window. We evaluate three vision-language models on three benchmarks, two of which are never seen in training. RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average. Under the outcome reward, GRPO and PPO fall below the base model on average. RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours. The trained agent answers with sufficient evidence in 51%, 12% and 74% of the episodes on the three benchmarks, against 8%, 0.4% and 36% for the base model. Its accuracy gain therefore comes from answering more often at high levels of evidence. The belief line shows how the agent reaches this evidence: it acts on its own belief. It commits at only 0.1 to 2.2% of the turns at which the evidence is insufficient and its line still names several answers, against 3 to 68% for the base model.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB)，利用模拟器可计算的后验奖励智能体在证据不足时继续探索、证据充分时提交答案，以减少“懒惰”提前作答。
summary.methods: 在每一步计算答案后验，奖励进一步步骤（当后验仍允许多个答案）和提交（当证据充分）；奖励不依赖评判器、批评者或奖励模型，也不读取智能体书写的信念行。引入 Pro Worlds 视觉谜题基准，在三个 VLM 和三个基准上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于强化学习、多模态学习与对齐方向，关注智能体在长任务中的证据驱动决策与信念对齐。
summary.caveat: 方法依赖模拟器可计算精确后验，可能限制其在真实开放环境中的适用性；摘要未讨论后验估计误差对训练的影响。

papers.title: PinGround: Pinning Queries to Points for Parallel Grounding in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can localize through their text interface, grounding open-vocabulary objects, complex referring expressions, text lines and layout regions with strong semantic understanding. They write the boxes one after another as a single sequence, although the instances of a query, unlike the words of a sentence, form an unordered set with no sequential dependence. The number of decoding steps therefore grows with the number of instances, which makes dense scenes the most expensive. Decoding the instances in parallel avoids this growth, but streams that cannot see each other duplicate some instances and miss others. We propose \method, which writes a single point into each query as a spatial anchor and asks for the matching instance nearest to that point within a local radius, or \none. Given the image, the anchored queries are independent, so they are decoded in parallel as leaves of a prefix tree that shares the image and the query, and the model is trained on the same tree. Coarse-to-fine anchors refine only the regions where instances are found, duplicate suppression keeps one box per instance, and set-level reinforcement learning optimizes the set F1. Only the prompt and the attention mask change, not the architecture. On three different VLMs and 12 benchmarks covering detection, OCR, layout and referring, \method is at most 5.5 F1 below sequential decoding trained on the same data, while its speedup grows with instance density and reaches 21.9$\times$ on dense scenes.

summary.takeaway: 提出 PinGround，将查询锚定到空间点以实现并行 grounding，通过前缀树并行解码独立锚定查询，并用集合级强化学习优化集合 F1，显著提升密集场景速度。
summary.methods: 在每个查询中写入一个点作为空间锚，要求模型在局部半径内选择最近匹配实例或返回 none；锚定查询作为前缀树叶子并行解码；由粗到细锚点细化、重复抑制和集合级 RL 训练。仅修改提示和注意力掩码，不改变架构。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于强化学习、多模态学习与跨模态理解方向，关注 VLM 的开放词汇定位与并行解码效率。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在密集场景加速达 21.9 倍，但 F1 最多比顺序解码低 5.5，存在精度与速度权衡；未讨论锚点选择对杂乱场景的敏感性。

papers.title: DiCT: Teaching X-ray Vision-Language Models to Reason via Imagining CT
papers.abstract: Diagnosing with X-rays often requires reasoning about the 3D locations of abnormalities and their spatial relationships to surrounding anatomical structures, yet such reasoning remains challenging due to the loss of spatial information in 2D projections. To address this challenge, we propose Dreaming in CT (DiCT), a three-stage progressive CT-to-X-ray reasoning transfer framework that leverages a CT vision-language model (VLM) to guide an X-ray VLM. Through this CT-guided transfer, the student acquires CT-informed 3D reasoning capabilities, enabling it to reason directly from 2D X-rays without explicit CT reconstruction at inference time. The framework begins with instruct the dreamer, which equips the X-ray student with initial CT-oriented reasoning capabilities and establishes a structured interface that distinguishes X-ray observations from CT imagination. Building on this structure, visualize the dream introduces CT-guided on-policy distillation (OPD), where the CT teacher selectively guides the X-ray student's reasoning trajectories to transfer 3D anatomical knowledge. Finally, manifest the dream adapts the acquired reasoning capabilities from digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) to real clinical X-rays. Experiments across two VLM backbones on 3D-RAD and ReXVQA demonstrate DiCT's effectiveness across radiological reasoning tasks, achieving a 1.66 percentage point improvement over a CT reconstruction-based baseline on 3D-RAD Abnormality Identification with 12.77$\times$ lower inference computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/HongYep/DiCT.

summary.takeaway: 提出 DiCT，一个三阶段渐进式 CT-to-X-ray 推理迁移框架，利用 CT 视觉语言模型引导 X 射线 VLM 获得 CT 启发的 3D 推理能力，推理时无需显式 CT 重建。
summary.methods: 三阶段包括：instruct the dreamer 建立 X 射线观察与 CT 想象的结构化接口；visualize the dream 使用 CT 引导的 on-policy 蒸馏传递 3D 解剖知识；manifest the dream 将能力从数字重建放射图适配到真实临床 X 射线。在两个 VLM 骨干和 3D-RAD、ReXVQA 上评估。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于多模态学习与跨模态理解方向，关注医学影像中的跨模态知识迁移与推理。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在 3D-RAD 异常识别上比 CT 重建基线提升 1.66 个百分点，提升幅度有限；依赖 CT 教师模型的质量，未讨论临床部署中的域偏移问题。

papers.title: LookAnything: A Foundation Model for Holistic Gaze Following
papers.abstract: Human gaze provides a rich window into attention and intent, making its understanding essential for applications ranging from social signal analysis to human-robot interaction. Existing methods typically employ highly customized architectures relying on auxiliary inputs like head crops or depth maps, causing cascading errors and inference overhead. Trained on single domains and confined to isolated gaze following with heatmap outputs, they lack flexibility and generalization for diverse interactive scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present LookAnything, a foundation model that unifies diverse gaze-centric tasks for holistic gaze following. Benefiting from large-scale multi-task and cross-domain training, LookAnything flexibly adapts to various settings, generating diverse outputs (points, boxes, heatmaps, and language) and supporting broad gaze-centric localization, description, and reasoning. At its core, we introduce learnable gaze-prior queries to promote gaze-aware representation learning, eliminating the need for auxiliary external inputs. To facilitate this paradigm, we construct HoliGaze, a comprehensive corpus and benchmark comprising 311K question-answer pairs across 5 capability dimensions and 9 distinct tasks. Experiments demonstrate that LookAnything consistently outperforms 33 leading vision-language models on holistic gaze following, while remaining highly competitive with dedicated specialists across 5 conventional target detection benchmarks. Evaluation on unseen datasets and deployment on a real robot further validate its strong out-of-domain generalization and flexible adaptation in real-world scenarios.

summary.takeaway: 提出 LookAnything，一个统一多种注视中心任务的全景注视跟随基础模型，通过大规模多任务跨域训练支持点、框、热图和语言等多种输出，无需辅助输入。
summary.methods: 引入可学习注视先验查询以促进注视感知表征学习；构建 HoliGaze 语料与基准，包含 311K 问答对、5 个能力维度和 9 个任务。在多个基准上评估，并与 33 个 VLM 及专用检测器比较，包含真实机器人部署。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于预训练、自监督与表示学习、多模态学习与跨模态理解方向，关注注视跟随的统一建模与泛化。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体性能数值与消融细节；大规模多任务训练的数据偏差和真实场景中的隐私问题未讨论。

papers.title: Sparse Hodge Preference Optimization: Fine-Tuning Language Models toward Alignment beyond Transitive Preferences
papers.abstract: The growing adoption of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), which leverages pairwise preference data, reflects its great success in fine-tuning large language models to align with human expectations. It directly optimizes the policy from human preferences without explicit reward modeling or the complexities of reinforcement learning-based approaches. However, the classic DPO relies on the Bradley--Terry sampling model and cannot effectively capture intransitivity or cyclic structures in aggregated human preference data. In this article, we propose Sparse Hodge Preference Optimization (SHPO), a preference optimization algorithm that augments DPO with a sparse antisymmetric curl residual motivated by the combinatorial Hodge decomposition. We prove that SHPO strictly enlarges DPO's hypothesis class on comparison graphs containing at least one triangle, under some mild regularity conditions on the response representations. We further establish a theoretical guarantee for $\ell_1$-regularized estimation of the curl coefficients under fixed policy and representations. Qualitative studies on three preference datasets under the same QLoRA budget, SHPO-aligned LLM achieves satisfactory performances in preference accuracy, cyclic structure recovery, and GPT-4o-judged generation quality.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Sparse Hodge Preference Optimization (SHPO)，在 DPO 基础上引入稀疏反对称旋度残差，以建模人类偏好数据中的非传递性或循环结构，并证明其严格扩大 DPO 的假设类。
summary.methods: 基于组合 Hodge 分解，在 DPO 目标中加入 ℓ1 正则化的反对称旋度残差；在三个偏好数据集上以相同 QLoRA 预算进行定性研究，评估偏好准确率、循环结构恢复和 GPT-4o 评判的生成质量。
summary.relevance: 直接关联大语言模型对齐与偏好优化，以及强化学习与奖励学习中的偏好建模问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告定性研究，未给出定量数值或统计显著性；理论保证依赖于响应表示的温和正则条件和固定策略/表示下的 ℓ1 估计。

papers.title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic bottleneck. Next, we analyze why scaling parameters alone leaves capacity under-trained unless data scales equally (Chinchilla), how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) left alignment superficial, and how that gap compounded into adversarial jailbreaks and single-direction refusal subspaces (J-space), where instructing a model not to think of a restricted concept surfaces it much like the human "red ball" paradox. Finally, we synthesize the current state of AI (2024-2026), encompassing recursive model collapse, autonomous reasoning-model jailbreak agents, machine-speed agentic intrusions, and closed-loop recursive self-improvement (AIDE^2).

summary.takeaway: 以 22 篇 influential 文献综述 1997–2026 年大语言模型演进，按时间锚定分类法串联从 RNN/LSTM 到 Transformer、RLHF、越狱与递归自我改进的关键范式转变。
summary.methods: 叙述性综述，围绕作者出生年（1999）组织因果时间线，覆盖 RNN 遗忘、LSTM 门控、Word2Vec、Transformer 注意力、Chinchilla 缩放、RLHF、对抗越狱、J-space 拒绝子空间及 AIDE^2 等主题。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、强化学习及多智能体与奖励学习相关，提供领域历史脉络与当前挑战的宏观梳理。
summary.caveat: 作为综述，其分类与因果叙事依赖作者主观选择；摘要未说明文献筛选标准或定量比较方法，不能视为系统性元分析。

papers.title: Adopting AI Technologies without Traps: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework
papers.abstract: AI technologies and AI agents play increasingly important roles in human society, including in education, economics, and research. Adopting AI technologies can bring immediate, and sometimes tremendous, rewards such as through productivity boost, but they can also bring negative effects including but not limited to losses of job and training opportunities, and cognitive capability declines. Thus, it is important to investigate the optimal ways of adopting AI technologies without different traps. In this paper, we develop a general multi-agent Markov decision process (MDP) based reinforcement learning (RL or MARL) modeling framework for determining and analyzing optimal adoption of AI technologies. This framework can model the long-term dynamic effects of AI adoption, and lead to finding the optimal AI adoption strategies. In our modeling framework, the negative effects of AI adoption are modeled by undesirable state transitions or negative rewards in the MDPs. The proposed multi-agent RL MDPs incorporate both human agents and AI agents. The key idea of our models is that incorporating AI technologies may not only increase the immediate rewards for AI agents but also alter the states of the involved human and AI agents. In particular, we apply this framework to analyzing AI offloading leading to skill erosion, to analyzing optimal human resource structures for a firm adopting AI, and to analyzing the economic equilibria in the trading/employment among human and AI agents. Since the multi-agent MDP based RL technique is from control, machine learning and AI, this research is essentially using an AI technique to determine the optimal ways of adopting or co-existing with AI without traps.

summary.takeaway: 提出基于多智能体 MDP 的强化学习建模框架，用于分析和求解 AI 技术采纳的最优策略，并将负面效应建模为不良状态转移或负奖励。
summary.methods: 构建包含人类与 AI 智能体的多智能体马尔可夫决策过程，应用 MARL 求解；应用于 AI 卸载导致技能侵蚀、企业人力资源结构优化以及人机交易/就业经济均衡分析。
summary.relevance: 直接关联强化学习与多智能体及奖励学习，关注 AI 采纳的长期动态与陷阱。
summary.caveat: 摘要为概念性框架与应用设想，未报告具体实验、数值结果或模型验证；实际最优策略的有效性尚需实证检验。

papers.title: Breaking the Joint Action Space Dependence in Distributionally Robust Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We study the sample complexity of learning robust coarse correlated equilibria (CCE) in finite-horizon, general-sum, distributionally robust Markov games with known rewards and a generative model of the nominal transitions. Each player evaluates a policy by its worst-case return over total-variation (TV) balls centered at the nominal transition distribution of every stage, state, and joint action; this is the standard $(s,a)$-rectangular uncertainty set. Existing generative-model guarantees for this model scale with the number $\prod_iA_i$ of joint actions, where $A_i$ is the number of actions of player~$i$. Since this number grows exponentially with the number of players, these guarantees suffer from the curse of multiagency. We design an algorithm whose sample complexity depends on the action sets only through the largest individual action-set size $A_*:=\max_iA_i$. The algorithm uses $\widetilde O(SA_*H^5D^4/\varepsilon^4)$ transition samples and, with probability at least $1-δ$, returns a Markov policy that is an $\varepsilon$-robust CCE from every initial state. Here $S$ is the number of states, $H$ is the horizon, and $D:=\max_i\min\{H,1/ρ_i\}$, where $ρ_i$ is the TV radius of player~$i$. Two ingredients make this possible: a plug-in estimate of the robust backup whose mean error does not depend on the number of states, and a single batch of samples per round that serves as bandit feedback for all players at once. The result shows that the dependence on $\prod_iA_i$ can be avoided without modifying the $(s,a)$-rectangular uncertainty set.

summary.takeaway: 在有限时域一般和分布式鲁棒马尔可夫博弈中，设计算法使学习鲁棒粗相关均衡的样本复杂度仅依赖最大个体动作集大小 A_*，而非联合动作数 ∏_i A_i，从而打破多智能体诅咒。
summary.methods: 在已知奖励和名义转移生成模型下，针对 (s,a)-矩形 TV 球不确定性集，使用鲁棒备份的插件估计和每轮单批样本作为所有玩家的 bandit 反馈；样本复杂度为 Õ(S A_* H^5 D^4 / ε^4)。
summary.relevance: 核心关联强化学习与多智能体及奖励学习，特别是鲁棒均衡学习的样本效率问题。
summary.caveat: 理论结果依赖已知奖励、生成模型访问和 (s,a)-矩形不确定性集等假设；摘要未提供实验验证，实际场景中这些假设可能难以满足。

papers.title: Assessing Robustness to Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Deep Reinforcement Learning for Cyber-Physical Systems
papers.abstract: As the use of reinforcement learning (RL) becomes more widespread in cyber-physical systems, it becomes increasingly important to design RL agents that are able to adapt to changes in their environments in order to maintain safety and reliability. This paper addresses the question of whether different classes of RL algorithm are more robust against forgetting previously learned behaviours, a critical issue in continual learning, in non-stationary environments. We evaluate the robustness of representative examples of three important classes of RL algorithm in a non-stationary autonomous parking environment. These are Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), which is a model-free on-policy algorithm, Soft-Actor-Critic (SAC), which is a model-free off-policy algorithm, and Drama, which is a model-based algorithm. The agents must learn to successfully park in four different scenarios, which are presented successively, with parking spaces oriented at varying angles. We find off-policy algorithms appear to be more robust compared to on-policy algorithms due to their use of replay, while model-based algorithms do not appear to offer any direct advantage over model-free algorithms. These experiments also highlight the additional challenges of finding robust abstractions of the environment, and oversensitivity to hyperparameters.

summary.takeaway: 在非平稳自主泊车环境中评估 PPO、SAC 和 Drama 三类 RL 算法对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性，发现 off-policy 算法因经验回放而更鲁棒，model-based 算法未显示直接优势。
summary.methods: 在四个 successively 呈现、停车位角度不同的泊车场景中训练 agent，比较 model-free on-policy (PPO)、model-free off-policy (SAC) 和 model-based (Drama) 算法的持续学习表现。
summary.relevance: 关联强化学习与持续学习，关注信息物理系统中非平稳环境下的遗忘鲁棒性。
summary.caveat: 实验限于单一自主泊车环境和三类代表性算法，结论的普适性有限；摘要未报告定量遗忘指标或统计检验，且指出环境抽象和超参数敏感性带来额外挑战。

papers.title: Lost on Campus: Evaluating Embodied Spatial Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in the Wild
papers.abstract: Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR) is central to deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in real-world embodied tasks, yet remains inadequately evaluated. Existing benchmarks primarily assess spatial reasoning in static images or synthetic indoor environments, where semantic shortcuts often suffice, making it difficult to faithfully evaluate spatial reasoning capabilities in the wild. In light of this, we present Lost on Campus, a benchmark for evaluating ESR in large-scale real-world outdoor 3D environments reconstructed by 3D Gaussian Splatting. Our benchmark introduces a unified reasoning-action evaluation framework that seamlessly integrates diagnostic QA for isolated reasoning with closed-loop interactive navigation for active reasoning under multimodal instructions. To enable fine-grained diagnosis, we evaluate six capability aspects of ESR: action grounding, spatial foresight, metric awareness, goal-directed planning, ego-allocentric localization, and spatio-temporal consistency. Extensive experiments reveal that: (i) Compared to indoor settings, real-world outdoor environments impose substantially higher demands on spatial reasoning, where existing models exhibit poor performance; (ii) VLMs still struggle with fine-grained visual alignment, with failures in spatial foresight and ego-allocentric localization emerging as primary bottlenecks; (iii) Improving multimodal interaction capabilities and long-term spatial reasoning is crucial for advancing embodied intelligence. These findings highlight that faithful evaluation of ESR demands benchmarks tightly coupling perception, reasoning and action within realistic and continuous environments.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Lost on Campus 基准，利用 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建大规模真实户外校园环境，统一诊断性 QA 与闭环交互导航，评估视觉语言模型的具身空间推理。
summary.methods: 构建真实户外 3D 环境基准，设计统一推理-行动评估框架，覆盖动作接地、空间预见、度量感知、目标导向规划、自我-异我中心定位和时空一致性六个能力方面；进行大量实验比较现有 VLM。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解生成，聚焦 VLM 在具身空间推理中的真实场景评估。
summary.caveat: 基准基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 重建环境，可能引入重建伪影；摘要未给出具体模型分数或统计细节，结论主要来自实验观察。

papers.title: Benchmarking Evidence Sufficiency in Vision-Language Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract: Reliable driving VLMs must do more than answer correctly or localize relevant scene actors: they must determine whether the available visual evidence is sufficient to support an answer. Existing evaluations largely treat grounding and answerability as separate measurements, making it difficult to distinguish well-supported predictions from those localized to relevant but insufficient evidence. We introduce DriveAnswer, a benchmark of 20,151 questions across seven reasoning families, that operationalizes this distinction using matched strong- and weak-evidence configurations. Each pair preserves the underlying scene fact and semantic answer while changing whether the observations support answering, making abstention the appropriate response under weak evidence. On the six-family evaluation, the strongest zero-shot baseline reaches 67.31% strong-evidence accuracy, yet only 21.55% of matched questions satisfy both answer-abstain behavior and complete grounding. With controlled adaptation, Gemma-4-12B reaches 63.29% on this joint capability, nearly tripling its zero-shot performance. Qwen3-VL-8B exhibits the same broad improvement in evidence-sensitive answering and grounding. These results show that semantic correctness, evidence sufficiency, and grounding are distinct capabilities that should be evaluated jointly.

summary.takeaway: 提出 DriveAnswer 基准，通过匹配强/弱证据配置区分语义正确性、证据充分性与 grounding，揭示自动驾驶 VLM 在弱证据下应弃答却常失败的能力缺口。
summary.methods: 构建 20,151 个问题、覆盖七个推理族的基准，每对强弱证据保持场景事实和语义答案不变而改变观察是否支持回答；评估零样本基线和受控适配后的 Gemma-4-12B 与 Qwen3-VL-8B。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解生成，针对自动驾驶场景中 VLM 的证据充分性评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告六族评估上的部分数值（最强零样本强证据准确率 67.31%，联合能力 21.55%），未覆盖全部七族；基准构建和匹配证据配置的有效性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Do Vision-Language Models Know Their Own Visual Weaknesses? Probing Capability-Level Metacognition
papers.abstract: Metacognition includes knowing one's own strengths and weaknesses across kinds of tasks, not only judging whether a single answer is correct. We test whether vision-language models (VLMs) know in advance which kinds of visual tasks and image conditions are hard for them, across a wide range of open and proprietary models. Because some tasks are hard for every model, we separate what a model knows about this shared difficulty from what it knows about itself. We find that VLMs know little in advance about their visual weaknesses. They misjudge their overall accuracy and do not even know which kinds of tasks are hard for every model, and most misjudge how degraded images affect them. We further train VLMs to predict their own accuracy, which teaches them their own level of accuracy on kinds unseen in training but not which kinds are hard for them. However, information about these weaknesses appears once a model starts solving. On a few unlabeled questions of a kind, the probability a model assigns to its own answers follows weaknesses particular to the model, across kinds of tasks and image conditions. VLMs thus hold information about their own weaknesses that their stated predictions do not yet reflect. By separating what is particular to a model from what holds for every model, our evaluation offers a test for methods that aim to teach VLMs their own weaknesses, and the answer probability offers them a signal to start from.

summary.takeaway: 检验视觉语言模型是否具备能力级元认知，发现模型事先很少了解自身视觉弱点，但一旦开始解题，其答案概率中会显现模型特有的弱点信息。
summary.methods: 在多种开源与专有 VLM 上，跨视觉任务类型和图像条件测试模型对自身难度的预测；分离共享难度与模型特有弱点，并训练模型预测自身准确率。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解生成，关注 VLM 的元认知与可靠性评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体数值或模型列表；结论基于所测模型和任务范围，训练模型预测准确率仅泛化到未见任务类型的自身准确率水平，而非识别哪些任务类型困难。

papers.title: Text Is Just Another Shot in Vision-Language Models: Simple Probes on Frozen Encoders Do It
papers.abstract: Few-shot adaptation of vision-language models has produced increasingly elaborate methods built on CLIP and on one shared principle: the zero-shot text classifier is the anchor, and labeled images only correct it. We argue that this principle reflects CLIP's visual features rather than a property of the task. We provide a simple Bayesian interpretation, in which a class name is worth exactly kappa = sigma^2 / tau^2 labeled images, the ratio between the visual spread of a class and the misalignment of its name. The Bayes classifier of this model counts text as kappa more samples. With modern frozen encoders, few-shot adaptation then reduces to a well-regularised convex probe. Specifically, we introduce TASP, a simple convex logistic regression on frozen features that incorporates class-name embeddings as weighted training examples and as a regularization prior. On the standard 11-dataset benchmark, TASP with frozen PE-Core-L features achieves 87.1% accuracy at 1 shot and 91.4% at 16 shots, outperforming state-of-the-art few-shot vision-language adaptation methods by 4.6 to 11.0 percentage points. While stronger representations explain much of this improvement, controlled comparisons on matched features show that existing frozen-encoder adaptation methods do not materially improve on this probe. We further find that the weight assigned to text matters more than how it is incorporated, and that combining self-supervised visual features with vision-language representations is most beneficial for weaker visual encoders. Together, these findings suggest that progress in few-shot vision-language adaptation depends more on representation quality and the appropriate use of text supervision than on increasingly complex adaptation mechanisms.

summary.takeaway: 提出贝叶斯解释，将类名文本视为等价于 kappa 个标注样本；据此设计简单凸探针 TASP，在冻结编码器上把类名嵌入作为加权训练样本和正则先验。
summary.methods: 在冻结特征上做凸逻辑回归，类名嵌入同时作为加权训练样本与正则项；在标准 11 数据集基准上，用冻结 PE-Core-L 特征评估 1-shot 和 16-shot 准确率，并与现有少样本视觉语言适配方法及匹配特征上的控制比较。
summary.relevance: 属于多模态学习与跨模态理解，讨论 CLIP 类视觉语言模型少样本适配中文本监督的作用，强调表示质量与文本监督使用方式而非复杂适配机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告 87.1%（1-shot）和 91.4%（16-shot），称领先 4.6 至 11.0 个百分点；但结论主要基于 11 数据集基准与 PE-Core-L 等冻结编码器，其他模态、编码器规模及真实下游分布下的泛化性尚未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Bridging the Gap between Continual Learning and Test-Time Adaptation with Domain Preview
papers.abstract: Domain shift is a major problem for training machine learning models. While Continual Learning (CL) assumes distribution shift during training and Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) considers new domains at test time, setups that require explicit online adaptation to domain shift during both phases remain under-explored. We propose continual learning with domain preview (CL-P), a new combination of CL and TTA where both train and test data suffer from distribution shift. The training phase of CL-P is analogous to domain-incremental learning while the testing phase consists of a TTA phase on a future domain (which we call preview), and an evaluation phase on all seen domains. The model must then adapt to new domains at train and test time. In this paper, we evaluate mainstream CL and TTA methods that adapt only at train or test time, as well as their naive combination. Experimentally, TTA heavily damages the domain on which the CL method has just trained and increases forgetting. Notably, this damage mostly comes from the BatchNorm statistics shared by all domains. In that sense, we propose DOSE (Dosing by Online Statistics of Each domain), which allows a seamless combination of any CL and TTA methods by adaptive domain inference at test time, where the adaptation is applied to each image in proportion to the probability that it comes from the preview domain. Through extensive experiments with ResNet and ViT backbones, various combinations of CL and TTA baseline methods and datasets considering diverse domains, we show that DOSE matches or improves on CL methods alone in all 24 settings and on the naive combination in all but one. The code can be found in appendix.

summary.takeaway: 提出持续学习与测试时适配结合的新设定 CL-P，并发现直接组合 TTA 会损害刚训练过的域、加剧遗忘，主要源于跨域共享的 BatchNorm 统计量；据此提出 DOSE 按图像属于预览域的概率按比例施加适配。
summary.methods: 定义训练阶段域增量、测试阶段先预览未来域再评估所有已见域的流程；评估主流 CL 与 TTA 方法及其朴素组合，并在 ResNet 与 ViT 骨干、多数据集多域设置下测试 DOSE。
summary.relevance: 直接对应持续学习与持续适应/预训练主题，关注训练与测试两阶段均存在分布偏移时的在线适配与灾难性遗忘。
summary.caveat: 摘要称 DOSE 在全部 24 个设置中匹配或优于单独 CL、除一个外优于朴素组合，但证据限于所选的 CL/TTA 基线、骨干与数据集组合，未说明域预览在真实部署中如何获得及计算开销。

papers.title: The IGVF Catalog Knowledge Graph
papers.abstract: The Impact of Genomic Variation on Function (IGVF) consortium is systematically characterizing how genomic variation influences regulatory elements, gene expression, and human phenotypes through thousands of experimental mapping and perturbation datasets alongside predictive models. To synthesize these diverse results into quantitative relationships and situate them within established biological knowledge, we developed the IGVF Catalog, a large-scale knowledge graph. Implemented in ArangoDB using schema-validated JSON records. Version 1.3 encompasses nearly 3 billion nodes across 14 entity types (including variants, coding variants, genomic elements, genes, transcripts, proteins, pathways, and ontology graphs for biosamples and phenotypes) connected by more than 8.6 billion edges across 31 relationship types. Edges encode statistical significance, effect sizes, source provenance, and biological context via ontology-linked hyperedges. The Catalog integrates 657 IGVF datasets spanning non-coding reporter and CRISPR perturbation screens (MPRA, STARR-seq, Perturb-seq), coding variant assays (VAMP-seq, SGE, MAVE, DUAL-IPA), and predictive models (scE2G, SEMVAR, cV2F, TLAND, and BlueSTARR), unified with extensive public context including GENCODE annotations, FAVOR and dbSNP variants, TopLD linkage disequilibrium, GWAS, QTLs, and protein interactions. Users can interrogate the Catalog through a web portal (https://igvf.catalog.org) Python and R clients, an OpenAPI-documented API featuring 86 endpoints supporting identifier and genomic-region queries, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling agent-assisted querying with large language models. We demonstrate the Catalog's utility for mechanistic interpretation across three case studies: resolving a FOXA1-dependent enhancer variant (rs11257655) regulating CAMK1D at a type 2 diabetes locus, distinguishing coding (GCKR rs1260326) and regulatory (HNF1A rs1169289) mechanisms for liver traits, and linking vascular CRISPRi-perturbed elements to CDKN2A/CDKN2B and NOS3 in coronary artery disease. Updated quarterly with open data and software, the IGVF Catalog provides a scalable resource for variant-to-function discovery.

summary.takeaway: 构建 IGVF Catalog 大规模知识图谱，整合 IGVF 实验与预测模型结果及公共基因组注释，用于变异到功能的机制解释。
summary.methods: ArangoDB 中基于 schema 校验的 JSON 记录实现；v1.3 含约 30 亿节点、14 类实体、86 亿余边、31 类关系，边编码统计显著性、效应量、来源与本体超边；整合 657 个 IGVF 数据集（MPRA、STARR-seq、Perturb-seq、VAMP-seq、SGE、MAVE、DUAL-IPA 及 scE2G、SEMVAR、cV2F、TLAND、BlueSTARR 等模型）与 GENCODE、FAVOR、dbSNP、TopLD、GWAS、QTL、蛋白互作等公共数据；提供门户、Python/R 客户端、OpenAPI API（86 端点）和 MCP 服务器。
summary.relevance: 与单细胞扰动、知识图谱及大语言模型辅助查询相关，为变异功能解读和扰动实验整合提供资源。
summary.caveat: 摘要展示三个案例研究，未给出图谱查询性能、数据一致性或因果推断效力的系统评估；知识图谱规模与整合质量依赖来源数据集，摘要未说明偏差或错误传播控制。

papers.title: HEART: Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer for ECG Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Learning robust representations from electrocardiograms (ECGs) is challenging because repeated cardiac cycles coexist with subtle and sparse diagnostic cues in local morphology and rhythm-level context. Existing ECG foundation models commonly rely on Transformerbased patch encoders with uniformly shared dense refinement pathways, limiting adaptive processing across heterogeneous ECG tokens. We propose HEART (Hierarchical Expert Adaptive Refinement Transformer), an ECG foundation model that introduces stage-specific conditional expert refinement during self-supervised pre-training. HEART places a local-level MoE over patch-level representations before temporal contextualization and a global-level MoE over context-integrated token representations after self-attention. Token-level Top-1 routing allows different patches or contextual tokens within the same ECG to follow different expert pathways. On public ECG benchmarks, HEART achieves strong performance under both linear probing and fine-tuning, with particularly large frozen-encoder gains on PTB-XL Form and Rhythm (+6.76 AUROC points each over the strongest protocol-reproduced baseline). Routing analyses provide qualitative evidence of complementary local and global expert specialization. We release our code and pretrained models at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HEART-5E9F.

summary.takeaway: 提出 HEART，一种在自监督预训练中引入阶段特定条件专家细化的 ECG 基础模型，在局部 patch 级和全局上下文级分别使用 MoE，并以 token 级 Top-1 路由让不同 token 走不同专家路径。
summary.methods: 基于 Transformer 的 ECG 自监督预训练；局部 MoE 置于 patch 表示进入时间上下文建模之前，全局 MoE 置于自注意力之后；在公开 ECG 基准上做线性探测与微调，并分析路由行为。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，关注生理信号基础模型中的条件化专家结构与冻结编码器评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在 PTB-XL Form 和 Rhythm 上冻结编码器较最强复现基线各高 6.76 AUROC 点，未给出其他数据集完整数值；路由分析仅为定性证据，专家专业化的因果作用未验证。

papers.title: SleepXA: Composing Pretrained Neural and Cardiac Foundation Models for Sleep Representation Learning
papers.abstract: Physiological signals recorded during sleep provide synchronized views of neural, cardiac, respiratory, and other bodily systems, while preserving modality-specific information. Existing EEG and ECG foundation models already capture rich but distinct physiological structure, motivating an alternative to training a multimodal sleep model from scratch: composing existing pretrained models. We introduce SleepXA, a framework that uses synchronized polysomnography (PSG) to compose independently pretrained neural and cardiac foundation models. SleepXA combines pretrained EEG and ECG encoders with lightweight encoders for additional PSG modalities, and learns shared and modality-specific representations through sleep-guided alignment. We pretrain SleepXA on 9,230 overnight PSG recordings from three large cohorts and evaluate it on 27 downstream tasks spanning sleep representation, clinical and disease prediction, and daytime physiological transfer. SleepXA ranks among the top two methods on 22 of 27 tasks. Controlled experiments further show consistent benefits across sensor configurations and EEG-ECG backbone choices, while pretrained initialization outperforms architecture-matched training from scratch and SleepXA surpasses alternative multimodal composition strategies. These results suggest that synchronized multimodal physiology can serve as a natural interface for composing existing physiological foundation models, yielding reusable representations that extend beyond sleep to clinical and daytime physiological settings.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SleepXA，通过睡眠引导对齐组合独立预训练的 EEG 与 ECG 基础模型及轻量其他 PSG 模态编码器，学习共享与模态特异表示。
summary.methods: 在 9,230 条过夜 PSG 记录（三个大型队列）上预训练，组合预训练 EEG 与 ECG 编码器；在 27 个下游任务上评估，包括睡眠表示、临床与疾病预测、日间生理迁移，并做传感器配置、骨干选择、从头训练及替代多模态组合策略的对照。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习，探索以同步多模态生理为接口组合已有基础模型而非从头训练。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在 27 个任务中 22 个排名前二，但未给出具体数值与统计显著性；结论基于特定队列与 EEG/ECG 骨干组合，跨队列、跨设备泛化仍需验证。

papers.title: Measuring Counterfactual Credit in a Replayable Wildfire-Suppression Benchmark
papers.abstract: In cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, learned critics are usually evaluated by how well they predict the team's return. Yet predicting a team's return and assigning credit to individual actions are distinct tasks. To test credit directly, we introduce FLARE (Fireline Learning Agents in a Replayable Environment), a stochastic wildfire suppression benchmark in which any moment of a fire can be replayed with different actions under the same random events. Replaying one step measures the immediate effect of each agent's suppression, which we call simulator credit and use for training. Replaying to the end of the episode measures the effect of each action, which we use for grading critics. In a comparison over eight seeds with multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO), simulator credit reduces the interquartile mean burn score (each cell's burning time, capped and averaged over the map; lower is better) from 26.6% with shared reward to 20.9%. Learned credit from a centralized COMA-style critic does no better than the shared reward. Four trained critics predict the team's return well, yet the credit they assign is 9 to 42 times larger than the credit measured by replay. The critics also give heterogeneous agents nearly identical action rankings. These results show that a good fit to the team's return is a weak test of a critic's credit.

summary.takeaway: 提出可重放野火扑救多智能体基准 FLARE，用重放测量反事实功劳（simulator credit），并发现良好拟合团队回报的 critic 在功劳分配上仍可能严重失真。
summary.methods: 构建随机野火环境，任一步可在相同随机事件下重放不同动作；单步重放测量即时效果并用于训练，整回合重放测量动作效果并用于评分 critic；以 MAPPO 在 8 个随机种子上比较共享奖励、模拟功劳与 COMA 式集中 critic，并分析四个训练 critic 的回报预测与功劳排序。
summary.relevance: 对应强化学习与多智能体奖励学习主题，也为检索增强与对齐中奖励/功劳评估提供了直接测试思路。
summary.caveat: 摘要局限在单一野火环境与 MAPPO 设置；模拟功劳需环境可重放，真实场景中的可重放性假设未讨论，结果能否推广到其他合作多智能体任务尚不明确。

papers.title: Model evaluation metrics of Virtual Cell Challenge 2026
papers.abstract: Virtual cell models aim to predict the effects of genetic, environmental, chemical and other perturbations in silico, reducing the dependency on complex and costly experiments. The Virtual Cell Challenge 2026 motivates the field toward this goal, tasking models with zero-shot prediction of the transcriptional responses to CRISPRi knockdowns in six human cell lines. The faithfulness of a model to the experiment is assessed by metrics that compare its predictions with the real data, and designing such metrics is not trivial. We developed the metrics of the 2026 Challenge around three principles: a metric should (i) reflect the biological information extracted from experiments, (ii) be calibrated on a repeat of the experiment, and (iii) resist shortcut solutions that raise the score without predicting the response. Here we present the six resulting metrics, the reasoning behind each of them, and their evaluations on the Challenge data. Two of the metrics compare the pseudobulk expression profiles of predicted and measured cells, while four assess the genes that respond to each perturbation, the central readout of a Perturb-seq experiment. The metrics are implemented in cell-eval2, an open-source Python package. On the Challenge data, all six metrics score a repeat of the experiment above the mean baseline, and the shortcut solutions that the metrics of the 2025 Challenge left open can no longer raise the score. The new metrics are therefore more robust than the previous ones.

summary.takeaway: 围绕三项原则设计 Virtual Cell Challenge 2026 的六个评估指标，并用重复实验校准，同时抑制 2025 挑战中可抬高分数但不预测响应的捷径方案。
summary.methods: 任务为零样本预测六种人类细胞系中 CRISPRi 敲低的转录响应；两个指标比较预测与实测细胞的 pseudobulk 表达谱，四个指标评估各扰动响应基因；指标实现于开源 Python 包 cell-eval2，并在挑战数据上评估重复实验与捷径方案。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动与虚拟细胞主题，关注 Perturb-seq 扰动响应预测的评测设计。
summary.caveat: 摘要称六个指标均将实验重复评分置于基线均值之上且堵住 2025 的捷径，但未给出效应量或与生物学验证的对应关系；指标有效性仅在该挑战数据上展示。

papers.title: A multimodal foundation model for tissue proteomics and morphology in cancer
papers.abstract: Cancer diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment decisions increasingly rely on integrating tissue morphology with specific molecular readouts of the tumor and its microenvironment. H&E histopathology provides scalable morphology, whereas multiplex spatial proteomics quantifies dozens of proteins in situ with spatial context, but remains selectively deployed, often with different marker panels across cohorts. This creates a translational bottleneck: most patients lack high-depth molecular profiling, and existing models rarely integrate morphology and spatial molecular data in a single framework. We present VirTues-M2, a multimodal foundation model that jointly learns from H&E and spatial proteomics using a novel vision transformer-based architecture. By encoding marker identity during pretraining, VirTues-M2 is robust to missing modalities, imperfect modality pairing or registration, and variable marker panels, enabling unified inference for tissue phenotyping, panoptic cell segmentation, virtual staining, annotation-free biomarker discovery, and reinforcement learning-based adaptive marker panel selection to reduce assay burden. As a concrete demonstration of translational utility, in a newly collected cohort of 1,053 treatment-naive non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with paired spatial proteomics and H&E, VirTues-M2 discovers high-risk and low-risk tissue signatures that stratify overall survival in both the discovery cohort and an independent validation cohort, outperforming current state-of-the-art stratification schemes; all enabled by VirTues-M2's ability to jointly analyze both modalities within a single model.

summary.takeaway: 提出 VirTues-M2，一个联合学习 H&E 与空间蛋白组的多模态基础模型；预训练中编码标记身份，从而对缺失模态、配对/配准不完美和可变标记 panel 具有稳健性。
summary.methods: 基于视觉 Transformer 架构，在 H&E 与多重空间蛋白组上联合预训练；支持组织表型、全景细胞分割、虚拟染色、无标注生物标志物发现及基于强化学习的自适应标记 panel 选择；在 1,053 例治疗初治 NSCLC 患者配对队列中做生存分层，并在独立验证队列评估。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与强化学习主题，并涉及多模态组织形态与分子表型的联合表示。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告风险签名在发现与独立验证队列均能分层总生存且优于当前分层方案，但该证据来自单一癌种与特定队列；跨癌种、不同 panel 与前瞻性临床效用未在摘要中验证。

papers.title: Load Balancing Neurons: Firing-Rate Control Sustains Plasticity in Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Neural networks in continual learning often lose plasticity: some neurons become inactive, while others fire almost constantly. This limits adaptation to shifting data and wastes capacity. Prior work mitigates this by periodically reinitializing low-utility units, but such resets can destroy previously learned features and do not proactively prevent low utility. We study a simple diagnostic measure: the firing rate of ReLU units, defined as the fraction of positive pre-activations. Low rates identify dead units, while very high rates indicate linearized, always-on units. Based on this view, we introduce a lightweight load-balancing mechanism that adjusts per-neuron thresholds to keep firing rates within a target range. Across continual ImageNet and class-incremental CIFAR-100, firing-rate distributions explain differences in plasticity across a range of approaches, including well-known techniques such as L2 regularization and non-affine normalization, and load balancing matches or exceeds reset-based methods on both benchmarks. The same mechanism carries over to reinforcement learning, improving Rainbow DQN on Atari over a LayerNorm baseline.

summary.takeaway: 提出以 ReLU 单元激活率为诊断指标，并引入轻量级负载均衡机制调整每神经元阈值，使激活率保持在目标范围内，从而在持续学习中维持可塑性。
summary.methods: 以 ReLU 单元正预激活比例为诊断量；设计逐神经元阈值调整的负载均衡机制；在持续 ImageNet、类增量 CIFAR-100 上对比 L2 正则、非仿射归一化及基于重置的方法；并迁移到强化学习中的 Rainbow DQN 与 Atari。
summary.relevance: 直接关联持续学习中的可塑性丧失问题，并延伸至强化学习场景，与给定主题中的持续学习和强化学习均相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体性能数值与统计显著性；重置类方法的具体比较细节及机制在非 ReLU 架构上的适用性未说明。

papers.title: Unjamming Deferrals: Supporting Students Through JAMN Bot, a Mobile RAG-Grounded Policy Assistant
papers.abstract: In some educational institutions, workflows such as the exam deferral process can be slow, inconvenient, and inconsistent, which creates the need to implement novel digital systems. This paper presents Schedulater, a mobile app for managing university exam deferrals. JAMN Bot is a Large Language Model (LLM)-powered chatbot integrated into Schedulater that provides context-aware support to help users understand the deferral process. The system features a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline using Ollama (Llama 3.2 3B) for self-hosted inference which enables policy-grounded responses without sacrificing privacy. We evaluate the system using a 43-item benchmark spanning Exam Deferral, Privacy, Scheduling, Cross-Policy, and Adversarial & Out-of-Scope questions, and report inter-rater agreement among our human evaluators alongside retrieval hit-rate metrics. Subsequently, we utilize an LLM-as-a-judge approach with GPT-5.4, revealing slight-to-moderate alignment with our raters that improves with answer quality, and check the ranking against a panel including Gemini 3.5 Flash and Qwen3.5 397B. The results of our study display trade-offs between open-weight and frontier models, as well as LLM-human evaluation alignment with answer quality. Schedulater demonstrates the feasibility of integrating lightweight LLMs into university administrative workflows with structured retrieval.

summary.takeaway: 展示将轻量级自托管 LLM 与 RAG 结合用于大学考试延期流程的移动应用 JAMN Bot，实现基于政策的隐私友好问答。
summary.methods: 使用 Ollama 托管 Llama 3.2 3B 构建 RAG 管道；构建 43 题基准覆盖考试延期、隐私、排程、跨政策及对抗/超范围问题；报告人工评分者间一致性与检索命中率，并用 GPT-5.4 做 LLM-as-a-judge 评估，另与 Gemini 3.5 Flash 和 Qwen3.5 397B 组成评审团比较排序。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型及检索增强与对齐主题相关，涉及 RAG 落地与 LLM 评估对齐。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体准确率数值；评估依赖小规模自建基准，LLM 评审与人类评分仅呈轻微至中度一致，结论受评估设计限制。

papers.title: Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning enhanced Federated Learning for Predicting Remaining Useful Lifetime
papers.abstract: Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is central to Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). The growth of industrial IoT has unlocked large multivariate sensor streams and enabled deep models - especially Transformers - for long-horizon sequence learning. However, transformers are parameter-heavy and data-hungry, while operational datasets are often siloed and privacy-sensitive. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this by training across clients without raw data sharing, but in practice many clients connect over lossy wireless links where UDP is preferred for low latency, making model exchange vulnerable to packet drops. We present a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework that adapts FL to lossy channels by selecting per-client layer subsets to transmit and capping retransmissions. This framework is trained with QMIX value-function factorization for scalability. We instantiate the approach with a Graph Convolution Position-Aware Transformer (GCPATr) for RUL forecasting. On the CMAPSS dataset, our MARL-enhanced FL (RL-FL) consistently improves mean square error over standard FL, with the largest gains at high packet loss (e.g., up to 18% improvement on FD003 at 50% loss). These results show that MARL is an effective countermeasure to wireless degradation in FL-based RUL prediction.

summary.takeaway: 提出协作式多智能体强化学习框架，在丢包信道上为联邦学习逐客户端选择传输层子集并限制重传，以提升 RUL 预测。
summary.methods: 以 QMIX 值函数分解训练 MARL 以适配丢包信道；用图卷积位置感知 Transformer（GCPATr）做 RUL 预测；在 CMAPSS 数据集上与标准 FL 比较 MSE。
summary.relevance: 同时涉及强化学习与多智能体方法，并应用于联邦学习下的剩余寿命预测。
summary.caveat: 仅报告 CMAPSS 上的结果；摘要中唯一数值为 FD003 在 50% 丢包下最高约 18% 改进，其他场景增益未量化；无线丢包模拟的设定细节未给出。

papers.title: SPARQL-Planned Single-Hop Traversal over a Live Knowledge Graph for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.abstract: Semantic retrieval struggles with multi-hop question answering on both recall and precision: gold passages are buried among distractors that degrade the reader's answer, and retrieving them requires reasoning over the query rather than matching it. GraphRAG techniques expand semantic retrieval by connecting passages to graph nodes and performing one or more hops of expansion after initial retrieval. This improves recall, but multi-hop expansion becomes expensive and brings additional noise into the retrieved set. We break this tradeoff by \emph{interleaving} dense retrieval with knowledge-graph traversal for complex multi-hop questions. Dense retrieval locates the first relevant regions of the search space at good recall, while traversal of a pre-existing external KG (Wikidata) restores precision and improves recall by confirming retrieved passages against a reasoning path through the KG. To keep traversal both question-adaptive and reliable, we have an LLM plan it as code generation task for graph traversal in SPARQL format but \emph{parse rather than execute} the query. On full 1{,}000-question splits under a shared corpus and reader, and with a single configuration applied identically to every dataset, we reach \textbf{62.5 / 75.1} EM/F1 on HotpotQA, \textbf{73.5 / 81.0} on 2WikiMultiHopQA, and \textbf{37.1 / 50.0} on MuSiQue, ahead of reproduced HippoRAG2, T\textsuperscript{2}RAG, and IRCoT on all three benchmarks. A second, token-matched setting stays ahead of T\textsuperscript{2}RAG on HotpotQA and 2Wiki while spending roughly its per-query budget. Executing the generated SPARQL instead of parsing it costs up to 11.4 EM, mostly because raw queries return empty results, not because of syntax errors.

summary.takeaway: 提出将稠密检索与外部知识图谱遍历交错进行：由 LLM 生成 SPARQL 风格的遍历计划但仅解析而不执行，以在保持召回的同时提升多跳问答精度。
summary.methods: 稠密检索定位初始相关区域，再在 Wikidata 上做单跳遍历以验证检索段落；LLM 以代码生成方式规划遍历，解析查询而非执行；在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、MuSiQue 全量 1000 题划分上使用统一配置与共享语料和阅读器，并与 HippoRAG2、T²RAG、IRCoT 比较。
summary.relevance: 直接关联检索增强与对齐及知识图谱主题，聚焦多跳 RAG 的召回-精度权衡。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出基准分数，未报告延迟与成本；摘要指出改用执行 SPARQL 最多损失 11.4 EM，主要因原始查询返回空结果，说明解析式方案依赖生成的查询结构质量。

papers.title: Automatic Occupational Coding through Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract: Annually 1.9 million deaths and 89.7 million disability-adjusted life years are caused by exposure to agents during work (e.g., welding fumes, silica dust, and noise pollution). To improve worker health, high-quality exposure assessments are crucial. Therefore, free-text job descriptions from large-scale occupational cohorts are manually standardized through occupational classifications and linked to hazardous exposures using Job Exposure Matrices (JEM). However, manual coding is slow, unreliable (i.e., 44-89% inter-coder reliability), and costly, due to i) short, ambiguous free-text job descriptions, ii) classifications containing hundreds to thousands of categories, and iii) the absence of gold standards. With 46%-79% accuracy, state-of-the-art automatic occupational coding tools achieve classification performance on human level. However, their performance drops to 17-26% on out-of-distribution datasets. Furthermore, their supervised architectures limit them to occupational classifications present in the training set. Consequently, JEM using other classifications are incompatible, leaving vital exposure-response associations unexplored. Our Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework, OPERAG, enables classification into any occupational classification without expert-labelled databases. It retrieves coding index information and combines this with Large Language Model-based classification. Validated on AsiaLymph's 36,062 real-world job descriptions, OPERAG achieved 42.6% occupational classification accuracy on the 4th coding level, substantially outperforming existing tools and approaching human coders' 51-56% inter-coder reliability. Using two JEM named ALOHA+ and SHOCK, 89.9-98.6% accuracy was achieved on exposure assessment. OPERAG approaches human-level, universal occupational classification, enabling efficient and effective large-scale exposure assessment to improve worker health.

summary.takeaway: 提出 OPERAG 检索增强生成框架，无需专家标注数据库即可将自由文本职位描述映射到任意职业分类，并用于暴露评估。
summary.methods: 检索编码索引信息并结合 LLM 分类；在 AsiaLymph 的 36,062 条真实职位描述上验证；使用 ALOHA+ 与 SHOCK 两个 JEM 做暴露评估。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型及检索增强与对齐主题相关，体现 RAG 在高风险领域分类任务中的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告第 4 级编码准确率 42.6%，接近但低于人类编码者 51–56% 的评分者间一致度；暴露评估 89.9–98.6% 的准确率定义与评估细节摘要未展开。

papers.title: Near-Zero Forgetting Is Not Enough: Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Continual Learning of Pretrained VLAs
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit near-zero forgetting in specific continual learning settings with experience replay. However, robustness to domain shift of learned tasks remains unexplored. In this work, we study the robustness of Pi0 fine-tuned with experience replay under out-of-distribution (OOD) data using the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. While the in-domain (ID) setup achieves near-zero catastrophic forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks quickly collapses. Specifically, we show that during the continual learning process, the OOD capabilities of the model degrade, following a shared representational pattern across domain shifts, which is also visible behaviorally in the two simpler suites. Representational analysis shows that drift concentrates in the multimodal and action features. Linear probes indicate that OOD features still retain task-relevant information, but appear unreadable, consistent with representation misalignment. These findings suggest that even when ID stability remains intact, severe OOD forgetting can still occur, accompanied by representational drift during continual learning.

summary.takeaway: 指出使用经验回放的 Pi0 VLA 持续学习虽在域内近乎零遗忘，但在 LIBERO-Plus 等分布偏移下旧任务的 OOD 性能会迅速崩溃，并伴随多模态与动作特征的表示漂移。
summary.methods: 在 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-Plus 基准上对 Pi0 做经验回放微调；比较 ID 与 OOD 表现；进行表示分析与线性探针，考察特征漂移与可读性。
summary.relevance: 同时关联持续学习与跨模态理解与生成，聚焦预训练 VLA 的持续学习鲁棒性。
summary.caveat: 为分析性研究，摘要未给出具体退化幅度数值；线性探针提示 OOD 特征仍含任务信息但“不可读”，其因果机制尚未确立。

papers.title: Lorentz symmetry in self-supervised representation learning
papers.abstract: Self-supervised learning (SSL) and explicit physical inductive biases have driven major advances in jet tagging, yet they are typically pursued along separate tracks. In this work, we unify both paradigms by integrating the Lorentz-equivariant Geometric Algebra Transformer slim (L-GATr-slim) architecture with the LeJEPA framework for representation learning. Pre-training on 100 million jets from the JetClass dataset, we optimize towards a latent space, which is invariant across physics-motivated jet augmentations. We demonstrate that enforcing Lorentz symmetry in the latent space is critical for representation quality and that this can be achieved either architecturally or learned via kinematic augmentations. With a standard non-invariant Transformer backbone, LeJEPA outperforms established autoregressive, masked particle modelling, and self-distillation baselines in linear- and MLP-probe accuracy, with L-GATr-slim providing further complementary gains. Across downstream benchmarks, our pre-trained models consistently outperform baselines trained from scratch or through different pre-training objectives.

summary.takeaway: 将 Lorentz 等变架构 L-GATr-slim 与 LeJEPA 自监督框架结合，表明在潜空间中施加 Lorentz 对称性对 jet tagging 的表示质量至关重要，且可通过架构或运动学增强学习实现。
summary.methods: 在 JetClass 的 1 亿个 jet 上预训练，优化对物理动机 jet 增强不变的潜空间；比较标准非不变 Transformer 骨干下的 LeJEPA 与自回归、掩码粒子建模、自蒸馏基线；用线性与 MLP 探针及下游基准评估。
summary.relevance: 关联预训练与自监督与表示学习主题，展示物理归纳偏置与 SSL 的结合。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出探针与下游基准的具体数值；结论限于高能物理 jet 数据，向其他领域的可迁移性未验证。

papers.title: LimoBench: How Street Smart Are Large Language Models?
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed how humans interact with information, enabling natural-language interfaces across various domains. They are increasingly deployed for geospatial applications including map-based question answering, location-based services, and natural-language interfaces to spatial databases. But are LLMs truly location-aware, able to reliably interpret and precisely answer location queries involving real-world coordinates, points of interest (POIs), and geospatial distances? To answer this concretely, we present LimoBench, a street-level benchmark of 82 natural-language location queries over seven canonical spatial operations: geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, directionality, range search, $k$-nearest-neighbor search, and spatial join. The queries are grounded in real map data of West Lafayette, Indiana, and are graded by location and semantic complexity. They are designed to probe LLMs' street-level spatial awareness, from simple lookups to multi-step spatial reasoning. We also present Limo, an approach based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) that enhances the location awareness of LLMs. Limo grounds LLMs in PostGIS-backed spatial data through a compact set of tools. We find that ungrounded models mostly achieve single-digit accuracy (3.1% for GPT-6 Luna) across different spatial operations. In contrast, the same models achieve near-perfect accuracy (99.3% for GPT-6 Luna) when given access to Limo's spatial tools through MCP. Current LLMs thus have limited and unreliable street-level spatial knowledge, while grounding provides accurate answers at modest overhead (+0.2 s latency, 7.7$\times$ tokens, and 2.2$\times$ cost for GPT-6 Luna). We release the benchmark, Limo toolset, and evaluation code to encourage the community to evaluate their own location-aware LLM approaches.

summary.takeaway: 提出街级位置查询基准 LimoBench 与基于 MCP 的 Limo 工具集，发现无接地 LLM 空间问答准确率极低，接入 PostGIS 空间工具后接近完美。
summary.methods: 构建 82 条自然语言位置查询，覆盖地理编码、逆地理编码、路径规划、方向性、范围搜索、k 近邻与空间连接七类操作，基于 West Lafayette, Indiana 真实地图数据并按位置与语义复杂度分级；Limo 通过 MCP 以紧凑工具集接入 PostGIS 空间数据。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型及检索增强与对齐相关，涉及 LLM 与外部结构化数据/工具的接地。
summary.caveat: 基准规模较小且限于单一城市，摘要未说明跨城市泛化；接地方案在 GPT-6 Luna 上增加 +0.2 s 延迟、7.7 倍 token 与 2.2 倍成本，开销权衡需进一步评估。

papers.title: Transport-Safe Evaluation of LLM Agents: Trajectory-Dependent Judge Error and Anytime-Valid Auditing
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are often ranked by an LLM judge whose error rates are measured once and reused for every agent. The corrected success rates can then be biased when the judge's errors depend on the trajectory and agents differ in the trajectories they produce for successes or failures. We derive the exact asymptotic bias and give a chain of checks from identification to simultaneous ranks. On a four-agent semi-synthetic benchmark, a scalar correction with oracle calibration has maximum bias 0.245 and mean pointwise coverage 0.016, and never recovers the full ranking (0/250 replications). Augmented inverse-probability weighting (AIPW) with a uniform or a design-aware random audit keeps the maximum bias below 0.003, with mean pointwise coverage of 0.939 and 0.950. In a 48-cell stress test, effective target support rises only from 0.209 to 0.805 as calibration grows from 600 to 4,800 labels, while audited AIPW keeps a mean absolute error of 0.018-0.020. Without calibration support, or with judge dependence within an externally justified bound, we report valid bounds or sensitivity sets and carry them into rank sets. An e-process confidence sequence stays valid, for a stable target, under predictable adaptive auditing and arbitrary stopping.

summary.takeaway: 论文指出LLM智能体评测中judge误差若依赖轨迹，单次标定的校正成功率会产生偏差，并提出基于审计的AIPW校正与随时有效(e-process)置信序列来获得有效排名。
summary.methods: 推导轨迹依赖judge误差的渐近偏差，构建从识别到同时排名的检验链；在四智能体半合成基准上比较标量校正与带随机/设计感知审计的AIPW，并进行48格压力测试和e-process有效性分析。
summary.relevance: 主题涉及大语言模型评测与对齐，直接关系到用LLM judge对智能体排序时的可靠性和统计有效性。
summary.caveat: 主要证据来自半合成基准和模拟设定，摘要未说明真实多智能体部署中的验证结果。

papers.title: PCC: Pivotal Channel Compensation for Layer Pruning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Treating independent layers as the minimal pruning unit allows layer pruning to efficiently eliminate many redundant parameters and achieve high compression rates. Layer pruning has become a promising and prevalent structured pruning technique for large language models (LLMs). However, multi-layer removal can lead to significant performance degradation for LLMs. Although some works have explored various compensation methods for pruned layers, they are inefficient and costly. Observing that the expression of a large proportion of information is concentrated on a small number of pivotal channels, we propose a novel post-pruning compensation method for layer pruning, called pivotal channel compensation (PCC). PCC can achieve significant performance improvement by compensating for a small number of channels through learnable linear transformations at the pruning interface. Besides, we propose a new evaluation metric, called channel-wise average performance improvement (CAPI), which can measure the efficiency of channel-wise compensation. Our experimental results across various LLMs demonstrate that PCC can achieve significant and consistent improvements and high CAPI on language modeling and zero-shot question answering for the state-of-the-art cross-layer and consecutive-layer pruning methods. Compared with existing compensation methods, PCC can achieve competitive results with fewer additional parameters and less training cost.

summary.takeaway: 提出PCC后剪枝补偿方法，利用少量关键通道的可学习线性变换缓解LLM多层剪枝带来的性能下降，并提出CAPI指标衡量通道级补偿效率。
summary.methods: 观察到信息集中于少数关键通道，在剪枝接口处对少量通道做可学习线性补偿；在多种LLM和跨层/连续层剪枝方法上评估语言建模与零样本问答，并用CAPI衡量效率。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型压缩与高效推理方向，与LLM结构化剪枝及性能保持相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体压缩率、参数量或与基线差距的数值，也未说明补偿训练的稳定性范围。

papers.title: Geospatial foundation models and deep learning for climate resilience: a review of transfer, uncertainty and decision readiness
papers.abstract: Geospatial foundation models can reuse information learned from large Earth-observation archives, but their value for climate resilience depends on whether that information transfers to unfamiliar events, regions and observing conditions. This review connects advances in deep learning with the evidence needed for hazard monitoring and early warning. A descriptive audit of 137 full-text hazard-application studies is interpreted alongside a separate corpus of 37 model and benchmark records. Ninety-eight application studies reported an out-of-distribution experiment, whereas headline evaluations included held-out events in 31 studies, regions in 25 and sensors in only two. None of the ten studies coded for geospatial foundation-model fine-tuning used sensor holdout as a headline test. Uncertainty-related methods were recorded in 16 studies, including two with explicitly calibrated probabilistic output. These overlapping counts describe evaluation practice within the coded corpus, not a ranking of model families. We distinguish Earth-observation representation learning from atmospheric forecasting and examine how labels, observability, forecast lead time and decision requirements constrain their contribution across flood, wildfire, drought, heat, cryosphere and cascading-hazard applications. We then develop a decision-backward evaluation framework: define the action and information available when it must be taken, reproduce the relevant shift, retain a matched task-specific baseline, and report misses, false alarms, reliability and end-to-end latency. The framework turns transferability from a broad model claim into a testable requirement for climate adaptation and risk management.

summary.takeaway: 综述地学基础模型在气候韧性中的应用，强调其价值取决于跨事件、区域和传感器条件的迁移能力，并提出面向决策的反向评估框架。
summary.methods: 对137篇灾害应用全文研究和37条模型/基准记录做描述性审计，统计分布外测试、不确定性方法和决策相关评估实践；覆盖洪水、野火、干旱、热浪、冰冻圈及级联灾害。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练与表示学习在地球观测中的应用评估，以及迁移和不确定性对下游决策的影响。
summary.caveat: 为综述与描述性审计，计数仅反映编码语料内的评估实践，不是模型家族排名；摘要未提供定量迁移性能结论。

papers.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data.
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. RESULTS: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.

summary.takeaway: 提出scGPL统一框架，联合建模基因调控网络的全局拓扑与局部TF-靶基因对，以兼顾图方法的结构信息和对方法的数据丰富优势。
summary.methods: 从全局调控图提取宏观特征，引入动态重要性引导的子图采样捕获局部依赖，融合全局表示与子图增强局部特征；在七个基准数据集上与现有方法比较。
summary.relevance: 直接面向从scRNA-seq推断基因调控网络(GRN)，属于GRN/Regulon主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要只报告最高13.7%提升，未说明各数据集上的具体表现、运行成本或对数据规模的敏感性。

papers.title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
papers.abstract: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. Predicting perturbation responses in unseen cell types and identifying perturbed genes from their transcriptional effects therefore remain challenging. Here, we show that both tasks can be addressed through a common linear decomposition of transcriptional responses into shared and perturbation-specific components. Building on this principle, we introduce BiPert, a simple linear framework for both forward perturbation prediction and inverse identification. For forward prediction, BiPert outperforms existing methods that use no external biological knowledge when predicting gene expression changes in unseen cell lines. Its few-shot extension, BiPert-FS, adapts to new cell lines using as few as ten measured perturbations. For inverse identification, BiPert-ID identifies perturbed genes from single-cell expression profiles, outperforming deep-learning methods in unseen cell lines and donors. We further show that perturbations whose effects transfer more consistently across cellular contexts are also easier to identify, even after controlling for perturbation effect size. Together, these results establish a connection between perturbation transfer and identification, and demonstrate that simple linear models provide strong, interpretable baselines for both tasks.

summary.takeaway: 提出BiPert线性分解框架，将转录响应分解为共享与扰动特异成分，统一处理前向扰动预测和反向扰动基因识别，并显示迁移性与可识别性相关。
summary.methods: 基于线性分解构建BiPert前向预测、BiPert-FS少样本适配和BiPert-ID反向识别；在未见细胞系和供体的单细胞扰动数据上评估，并与深度学习方法及无外部知识方法比较。
summary.relevance: 属于单细胞扰动建模主题，关注跨细胞环境泛化和从表达谱识别扰动基因。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集规模、定量指标或线性模型失效条件的系统分析。

papers.title: BoolFunc-EA: A Boolean-evolutionary approach for accurate inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data.
papers.abstract: Network inference is the process of discovering genetic information from time-series data. The inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series data represents a significant challenge in bioinformatics. Despite the development of many Boolean network inference methods, most struggle with scalability as they impose restrictions on regulatory genes for each target gene. Other methods suffer from local optimum issues or are unable to compute the exact mutual information between a regulatory gene and its target gene. To resolve these issues, we present a novel method referred to as BoolFunc-EA, which employs Boolean functions and a genetic algorithm to infer gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data. BoolFunc-EA is a two-stage algorithm. First, we employ a set of limited Boolean functions to search for a regulatory gene. If a regulatory gene is not identified at this stage, a genetic algorithm is applied to determine a set of regulatory genes. In particular, this study introduces a hybrid crossover operator and a new fitness function that enhances information inheritance, improves solution evaluation, and provides a more effective solution representation within the proposed genetic algorithm framework. To assess the effectiveness of BoolFunc-EA, we conducted a wide range of experiments on both artificial and real gene expression datasets. Findings from the artificial dataset reveal that BoolFunc-EA consistently outperforms benchmark methods, including LogicGEP, LogBTF, MIBNI, LBF-MI, CLR, RelNet, Genie3-time, dynGenie3, and Jump3. The proposed method was further evaluated on the budding yeast cell cycle network and on fifty gene regulatory network datasets generated using the GNW tool. Its performance was then compared with that of nine benchmark methods. Results from real gene expression datasets also show that BoolFunc-EA consistently achieves superior F-score values, even on biological networks. Taken together, BoolFunc-EA is an efficient, scalable, and robust tool for gene regulatory network inference. The source code and reproducible experimental results are freely accessible at https://github.com/Dr-Shohag-Barman/BoolFunc-EA.

summary.takeaway: 提出BoolFunc-EA两阶段方法，结合有限布尔函数搜索与遗传算法从时间序列表达数据推断基因调控网络，并设计混合交叉算子和新适应度函数。
summary.methods: 第一阶段用有限布尔函数搜索调控基因，未识别时用遗传算法确定调控基因集合；在人工数据和真实数据上评估，包括 budding yeast 细胞周期网络及GNW生成的50个GRN数据集，并与九种基准方法比较。
summary.relevance: 直接属于GRN/Regulon推断，针对时间序列基因表达数据的布尔网络推断。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体F-score数值、计算复杂度或不同噪声水平下的稳健性细节。

papers.title: Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables
papers.abstract: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).
