summary.takeaway: 提出Tablassert工具，通过YAML声明式配置把生物医学论文表格转换为符合NCATS Biomedical Data Translator标准的知识图谱。
summary.methods: 解析Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet表格，按用户声明的subject-predicate-object-qualifier映射，解析自由文本到标准标识符，附加来源与统计信息并输出图文件。
summary.relevance: 涉及知识图谱构建及生物医学表格知识抽取。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出抽取准确率、覆盖规模或与人工整理结果的对比评估。

papers.title: Foundation Model and Radiomics Distance Scores for Post-Hoc Segmentation Failure Detection
papers.abstract: Medical image segmentation models can fail silently when clinical data differs from training data. Deployed models rarely ship with quality control, and are often black boxes. Prior methods that work in this post-hoc failure detection setting still need a separate regression or segmentation model, registration, or access to model internals. We instead propose two failure scores based on the Mahalanobis distance to a labeled reference set. The first uses radiomic shape features of the predicted mask. The second uses frozen foundation model (FM) features, made mask-aware by overlaying the mask on the image, encoding it with a frozen DINOv3, and pooling patch features with more weight on the mask region. We test on multi-site prostate and hippocampus MRI under imaging-protocol and population shift. Ranking cases by predicted failure risk within each site, both scores are competitive with the registration-based (Atlas-RCA) and ensemble-based (pairwise Dice) baselines, without registration that can fail silently or access to individual predictions. Our results show that pooling all test cases into one ranking, as prior work does, rewards ordering sites by difficulty, so a detector can rank sites well, miss failures within them, and still look strong. Within-site evaluation measures true per-case failure. The two evaluation schemes reward different behavior, so we recommend reporting both. The code is available at https://github.com/imigraz/fm-radiomics-failure-detection.

summary.takeaway: 提出两种基于马氏距离的后验分割失败检测分数，分别使用放射组学形状特征和冻结DINOv3基础模型特征，无需配准或模型内部访问即可竞争现有基线。
summary.methods: 以标注参考集计算马氏距离；一种用预测掩膜的形状特征，另一种将掩膜叠加到图像后用冻结DINOv3编码并按掩膜区域加权池化patch特征；在多站点前列腺和海马MRI的成像协议与人群偏移下评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练基础模型特征在下游医学图像质量检测中的复用，以及分割失败检测。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体检测性能数值；评估限于前列腺和海马MRI两类任务，跨模态泛化未说明。

papers.title: Revisiting Continual Learning in Language Models: A Three-Interface Diagnosis of Stability and Plasticity
papers.abstract: Continual learning in language models is commonly studied in the incremental learning (IL) setting, where a model learns a sequence of tasks and is evaluated through its final classifier or language-model (LM) head. This interface, however, does not indicate where forgetting occurs: a drop in accuracy may reflect representation degradation in the backbone, readout mismatch in the head, or both. We therefore argue that backward transfer (BWT) and forward transfer (FWT) should be interpreted as interface-dependent quantities rather than as single modellevel properties. We study three evaluation interfaces: the trained head, which is updated sequentially with the backbone; a probe newly trained on frozen backbone features; and a classifier-free backbone diagnostic. They measure deployed performance, recoverability under a new readout, and representation separability, respectively. Across class-incremental experiments with encoder and decoder language backbones, plus task-incremental sanity checks, conclusions about forgetting and plasticity change with the interface: the trained head often indicates severe forgetting, the probe near-complete recoverability, and the backbone diagnostic intermediate representation drift with a consistent negative relation between stability and plasticity. This relation holds for clustering-free diagnostics such as nearest-class-mean accuracy and across five clustering algorithms and three metrics. Finally, Just LM-Head Tuning (JLT), a head-only intervention on a fixed incrementally trained backbone, recovers 96-99% of the gap to joint training for replayand distillation-based methods but only about three quarters for plain sequential fine-tuning, suggesting that many failures attributed to catastrophic forgetting reflect head-backbone mismatch plus partial representation drift. Our results call for reporting where forgetting is measured, not only how much.

summary.takeaway: 论文主张持续学习中的遗忘与可塑性应视为依赖评测接口的量，而非单一模型级属性；不同接口会得出不同的遗忘与可塑性结论。
summary.methods: 基于编码器与解码器语言主干做类增量实验，并辅以任务增量检查；对比三种接口：随主干顺序更新的已训练头、在冻结特征上新训练探针、无分类器主干诊断，并做仅调头的干预实验（JLT）。
summary.relevance: 直接针对持续学习中的稳定性—可塑性权衡与灾难性遗忘评测口径问题，对持续学习研究的方法设计有参考价值。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集与模型规模等细节；结论基于摘要所述实验范围，尚需外部复现验证。

papers.title: Integrating CRISPRi perturbation responses and transcription-factor binding priors for regulatory network inference in triple-negative breast cancer
papers.abstract: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) represents an aggressive breast cancer subtype that lacks actionable cell-surface receptors, restricting frontline systemic management to cytotoxic chemotherapy. While recent functional epigenomics shows that TNBC progression is governed by non-coding regulatory remodeling at distal super-enhancers, conventional Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference methods rely on observational transcriptomic co-expression, which suffers from technical dropouts and confounding correlations that inflate false discoveries (>30%). Here, we present an interventional network inference framework that integrates large-scale single-cell CRISPR-interference perturbation sequencing (Perturb-seq; GSE224986, 95,678 cells across 11,975 sgRNAs) with ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq physical transcription factor binding priors across 819 somatic mutation-associated enhancer loci in human TNBC (MDA-MB-231). Our pipeline reconstructed a tripartite network yielding 5,935 physical TF-enhancer edges, 383,757 functional enhancer-gene edges, and 542,760 unique TF-target gene functional pairs across 372 active enhancers. Topological centrality prioritized master transcriptional drivers governing TNBC oncogenic signaling, including CTCF, POLR2A, EP300, JUND, MYC, and FOS, which regulate Hallmark programs for Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition (p = 1.2 x 10-9) and cell cycle progression. Explainable machine learning (SHAP TreeExplainer) revealed non-linear, thresholded transactivation dynamics for AP-1 and MYC. Quantitative benchmarking against held-out CRISPRi ground truth demonstrated strong discriminatory accuracy (AUROC = 0.8999, AUPRC = 0.8745, Precision = 90.13%, FDR = 9.87%), substantially outperforming GENIE3 (AUPRC = 0.6323, FDR = 35.73%) and co-expression correlation (AUPRC = 0.6814). In silico-simulated driver feature silencing correlated with experimental responses (R2 = 0.473, p < 10-122), and master driver signatures significantly stratified overall survival in the METABRIC (n = 320) and TCGA-BRCA (n = 160; p [≤] 0.019) cohorts. Finally, in silico perturbation modeling indicated that multi-target epigenetic combinations achieved 93% topological disruption of oncogenic regulatory connectivity, nominating prioritized candidate circuits for experimental validation.

summary.takeaway: 提出整合单细胞CRISPRi扰动响应与转录因子结合先验的干预式框架，用于在三阴性乳腺癌中推断基因调控网络。
summary.methods: 结合Perturb-seq（GSE224986，95,678细胞、11,975 sgRNA）与ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq结合先验，在MDA-MB-231的819个体细胞突变相关增强子位点上构建TF-增强子-基因三分网络，并用SHAP分析与CRISPRi留出数据基准评测。
summary.relevance: 同时关联单细胞扰动数据与GRN/Regulon推断，符合以扰动信息改进调控网络重建的研究方向。
summary.caveat: 摘要为预印本自述结果，基准依赖特定细胞系与数据来源；所报告的优越性需独立验证，且体内与临床转化性有限。

papers.title: Population-level learning of non-additive effects enables accurate and efficient prediction of combinatorial perturbation responses
papers.abstract: Combinatorial perturbations are widely used to study genetic interactions and to develop drug combinations, but the number of possible combinations grows quadratically with the number of perturbations, and only a small fraction can be measured in a screen experiment. Despite their growing sophistication, deep-learning and foundation models often fail to outperform a simple additive baseline based on measured single-perturbation responses. This suggests a simpler approach that builds on these measurements and directly learns deviations from additivity at the population level. We therefore developed GAIN, a lightweight model that implements these principles by predicting the pseudobulk response to a combination as the sum of its two single-perturbation responses and a learned interaction term. Across three single-cell datasets of genetic and drug combinations, GAIN corrected deviations from additivity and outperformed the additive model and cell-level methods across generalization settings and metrics, while training 3- to 64-fold faster. Applied to a combinatorial CRISPR screen of leukemia differentiation regulators, GAIN revealed synergy between key regulators of the differentiation block and genes that restrain differentiation but have little effect alone. It also revealed dampening by the histone chaperone FACT, which supports the induction of differentiation genes. These results establish population-level modeling of the deviation from additivity as a simple, accurate and scalable approach to predicting combination responses.

summary.takeaway: 指出深度学习与基础模型常难胜过简单加性基线，并提出在群体水平学习非加性偏差的轻量模型GAIN以预测组合扰动响应。
summary.methods: GAIN将组合的伪批量响应预测为两个单扰动响应之和加一个学习到的交互项，在三个单细胞遗传与药物组合数据集上评测，并应用于白血病分化调控因子的组合CRISPR筛选。
summary.relevance: 面向单细胞扰动预测与组合扰动外推问题，与预训练模型在扰动预测中的定位直接相关。
summary.caveat: 方法以伪批量层面建模，可能丢失细胞异质性信息；摘要未说明跨数据集迁移与未见扰动类型的充分评估细节。

papers.title: Similarity-Constrained Reweighting for Complex Query Answering on Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Machine learning models for Complex Query Answering (CQA) on knowledge graphs estimate the likelihood of answers that are not reachable via direct traversal. Recent work has proposed extending such queries with soft entity constraints, which require the target variable to be similar or dissimilar to specified sets of entities. We study a more general formulation where similarity constraints are specified on an arbitrary variable in a query, and introduce SCORE: a computationally efficient and interpretable method for incorporating similarity constraints on an arbitrary variable of a query. SCORE is based on a lightweight and interpretable score adjustment function that only requires tuning two hyperparameters on a validation set. Our experiments show that SCORE effectively incorporates preferences while maintaining strong query answering performance. It significantly improves ranking quality when constraints apply to the target variable and performs effectively in the more general case involving constraints on intermediate variables, and its performance remains robust when applied to several existing methods for CQA. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/dfdazac/score.

summary.takeaway: 提出SCORE，用轻量可解释的分数调整函数把任意变量上的软相似性约束纳入知识图谱复杂查询回答。
summary.methods: 将相似性约束推广到查询任意变量，设计只含两个需在验证集上调的超参数的分数调整函数，并在多个现有CQA方法上测试排名质量。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱上的复杂查询回答研究，扩展了带实体相似性约束的查询形式。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集与基线数值；方法依赖验证集调参，约束定义与超参数敏感性需进一步考察。

papers.title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
papers.abstract: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. GraphSeer bridges them inside one multimodal LLM: it links the photo to the graph, reads the facts of the best match, and retrieves with the hidden state at which the model is about to say the answer. An unseen entity has no facts of its own, but every candidate answer does, so a listwise verifier reads the other end of the graph: it re-ranks the top candidates by their facts and photos in one forward pass, and the facts matter far more than the photos. With Qwen3.5-27B, GraphSeer improves MRR on known entities by 24.2-70.0% over an MLLM embedder fine-tuned on the same data with the same budget. When it also fuses and verifies the embedder's candidates, it improves MRR on unseen entities by 12.5-25.6%, and on known entities it beats KG-completion models given the ground-truth entity ID.

summary.takeaway: 提出知识图谱关系图像检索任务（KRIR），并给出GraphSeer：在多模态LLM内部完成从照片到图谱实体的链接与关系检索。
summary.methods: 基于YAGO、Wikidata与OVEN照片构建三个基准；GraphSeer将照片链接到图谱、读取最佳匹配事实，并用模型将答未答时的隐藏状态检索，另用列表式验证器结合候选答案的事实与照片重排；实验使用Qwen3.5-27B。
summary.relevance: 连接多模态知识图谱与图像检索，拓展了知识图谱推理在多模态场景下的任务设定。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的是相对提升幅度，未给出绝对MRR；依赖单一MLLM骨干，基准由作者构建，泛化性待验证。

papers.title: Dually Constrained Parameter Projection for Continual Learning
papers.abstract: Continual learning requires a model to learn multiple new tasks sequentially while retaining performance on previous tasks. Projecting model parameters onto the Jacobian null space of previous tasks after unconstrained training on a new task has emerged as an effective paradigm. However, unidirectional projection merely minimizes the parameter distance to the new-task optimum, overlooking the new-task loss landscape. To address this limitation, we propose DUET, a bidirectional projection algorithm that imposes Jacobian null-space constraints from both previous and new tasks during post-training projection. Specifically, DUET formulates the post-training adjustment as a dually constrained optimization problem. It minimizes the distance between parameters before and after training on a new task, subject to loss preserving constraints on both tasks. To solve the optimization problem, we develop an alternating bidirectional projection algorithm, whose convergence is guaranteed by the contraction mapping theorem. For reliable multi-step projection, we rectify existing step size selection criteria via an effective-rank aware formulation, overcoming their failure under rank-deficient Jacobians. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET consistently outperforms existing unidirectional projection methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple datasets.

summary.takeaway: 提出DUET双向投影算法，在训练后投影中同时施加新旧任务的Jacobian零空间约束，而非仅单向投影。
summary.methods: 将训练后调整表述为双重约束优化问题，用交替双向投影求解并以压缩映射定理保证收敛；针对秩亏Jacobian改进步长选择，在多个数据集上与单向投影方法比较。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习中基于参数投影缓解遗忘的主流范式改进，与稳定性—可塑性权衡主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明具体数据集、主干网络与计算开销；收敛保证依赖所设假设，实证范围需查看全文。

papers.title: HEAR, SEE, SPIKE ONCE: Highly Efficient NeuroAI Temporal Neural Networks for Low-Precision Multimodal Audio-Visual Classification and Online Learning
papers.abstract: Spiking neural networks for multimodal audio-visual classification reach high accuracy by adopting deep-learning machinery: multi-stage convolutional or transformer encoders trained end-to-end with surrogate-gradient backpropagation through time. These prior works typically rely on full-precision (32-bit) parameters and do not treat hardware efficiency as a primary design objective. In this paper, we propose NeuTNN-AV, a much simpler hardware-amenable multimodal substrate built on the recently proposed NeuroAI Temporal Neural Network (NeuTNN) and demonstrate that it can match or outperform state-of-the-art SNN baselines with a fraction of their synapse counts. NeuTNN neurons carry multiple active dendritic segments. Each input line spikes at most once (temporal coding) and every weight is learned via a local reward-modulated spike-timing dependent plasticity (STDP) rule. All weights are 4-bit integers and inference uses only comparisons and additions. On CREMA-D, it reaches 78.6% with 2.34M synapses establishing a new state-of-the-art SNN accuracy, against 77.14% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). On UrbanSound8K-AV, NeuTNN reaches 98.82% with 1.38M synapses, against 96.85% for SMMT (9.99M parameters) and 98.96% for MISNet-XL (31M parameters). Weight memory is 23-106x smaller than the spiking baselines, and the measured synaptic energy per inference is two to three orders of magnitude lower. Furthermore, the proposed NeuTNN learns CREMA-D in a single pass with 73.8% accuracy and demonstrates rapid online continual learning by adapting to unseen actors from a few dozen clips.

summary.takeaway: 提出NeuTNN-AV，用4位整数权重、局部STDP学习与单次脉冲时间编码的简约脉冲网络，在多模态视听分类上以更少突触达到或超过现有SNN基线。
summary.methods: 基于NeuTNN神经元的多活跃树突段结构，所有输入线至多发放一次，权重经奖励调制STDP学习；在CREMA-D与UrbanSound8K-AV上评测，并测试单遍学习与在线持续学习。
summary.relevance: 涉及持续学习中的在线适应与低精度高效神经形态模型，与持续学习主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要中准确率与能效数据为作者自述，能效为测量估计；在线适应仅在小样本未见说话人场景演示，规模有限。

papers.title: The IGVF Data Portal: a repository for insights into genome function
papers.abstract: The Impact of Genomic Variation on Function (IGVF) Consortium has utilized a wide variety of assays and computational methods to study how genomic variation impacts function. To support the collaborative efforts of labs within IGVF, and to share the results of these efforts, the IGVF Data Administration and Coordination Center (DACC) has developed a data portal (https://data.igvf.org/) that serves as the repository for all results from the IGVF Consortium and as the source of results that have been integrated into the IGVF knowledge graph. Data generated by the IGVF Consortium, which has reached over 240 terabytes as of November 2026, can be publicly accessed via web browser, or programmatically via API, as well as via agentic tools. Here, we provide a summary of the available IGVF data and an overview of the design of the IGVF Data Portal.

summary.takeaway: 介绍IGVF联盟数据门户，作为其全部结果的存储库并作为已整合进IGVF知识图谱的结果来源。
summary.methods: 由IGVF数据管理与协调中心（DACC）建设的门户（data.igvf.org），支持网页、API与智能体工具访问，截至2026年11月数据量超过240 TB。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱相关的数据资源与基础设施介绍，为基因组功能研究提供整合数据入口。
summary.caveat: 摘要为资源与平台概述，不含方法学性能评估；知识图谱整合的具体范围与更新机制需查阅全文。

papers.title: A Text-to-SQL Benchmark for Official Statistics
papers.abstract: Official statistics are critical datasets for a wide variety of actors, including policymakers and businesses. For providers of official statistics, improving accessibility, governance, and disclosure of their data is of key importance. This can be improved by providing question-answering systems based on text-to-SQL approaches. However, existing text-to-SQL benchmarks do not resemble this setting. Official statistics are published as open-domain catalogs of thousands of wide tables whose columns and values are codes, and whose meaning is recorded in separate metadata rather than in a relational schema. To address this gap, we introduce LOCuST, a text-to-SQL benchmark that pairs over two thousand English and Dutch tables from Statistics Netherlands with a semantic knowledge graph. The graph describes the tables, measures, and dimension codes through labels, definitions, hierarchies, and units, and is the external knowledge a system needs to find the right tables and ground a question in the right codes. The benchmark includes expert-annotated questions for different query and aggregation types, including raw value retrieval, summations, proportion calculations, and joins. Alongside standard evaluation measures, we introduce an observation F1 metric that measures how close a query is to the ground truth even when the answers are different. We evaluate a variety of state-of-the-art LLMs and find that they struggle to write SQL that answers the questions correctly.

summary.takeaway: 提出 LOCuST，一个面向官方统计的 text-to-SQL 基准，将 Statistics Netherlands 的表格与语义知识图谱配对，并引入 observation F1 指标；评测显示现有先进 LLM 难以正确生成回答问题的 SQL。
summary.methods: 构建包含两千余张英文和荷兰语表格的基准，表格与描述表、度量、维度代码的语义知识图谱（含标签、定义、层级、单位）配对；包含专家标注的不同查询与聚合类型问题（原始值检索、求和、比例计算、连接）；除标准评估指标外提出 observation F1；评测多种先进 LLM。
summary.relevance: 该工作与知识图谱主题相关，因为其核心设计是用外部语义知识图谱为开放域宽表提供标签、定义、层级和单位等语义信息，以支撑表格查找与问题中代码的语义 grounding。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出各 LLM 的具体性能数值，也未说明 observation F1 的具体定义与计算细节；基准仅覆盖 Statistics Netherlands 的英荷双语表格，向其他统计机构或语言的泛化性未在摘要中讨论。
